## What it is

Desk foot for the matrix housing. It uses the same four horizontal M3 holes and the same cradle height as `matrix_16x16_base_mount`, so the housing can go on the lamp or on a desk without a second hole pattern.

## Design notes

- Prints foot-down. The M3 bores are teardrop-crowned so they print round with no support.
- Hole centers are X = ±30 mm, Z = 36 mm and 66 mm, on the upright face at Y = -10 mm. Nuts sit on the flat rear faces of the pillars.
- The foot is 150 × 120 mm with two lightening windows, long enough to stand the 181 mm panel up without the Arduino bay tipping it over.
- The uprights stop at Z = 76 mm. The Arduino shell starts at Z = 93.6 mm, so the bay clears the stand.

## Don't

- Don't raise the uprights into the shell. The shell bottom is 17 mm above the pillar tops on purpose.
- Don't move the four holes. They are the original housing's base-mount pattern.

- 2026-11-01: desk stand sharing the original 4× M3 pattern.
